name: LFM2.5 24B A2B
summary: Liquid AI's LFM2.5 24B mixture-of-experts: 64 experts with 4 used per token (about 2B parameters active), short convolutions in 30 of its 40 blocks and attention in 10. On one Arc Pro B70 in 8-bit form it runs at 111 tok/s with output identical to llama.cpp's plain path.

architecture.type: mixture of experts with hybrid convolution and attention

transfer_scope.status: one measured weight revision on one card; other quantizations, runtimes and card counts need their own gates

b70_fit.basis: The Q8_0 file is 25.5 GB; with a 32K F16 cache it runs on one card (measured).
